services.title: Towing
services.body: Vehicles and equipment are secured and moved the way the load actually calls for.

reviews.author: Houston Johnston
reviews.text: Super friendly when we spoke several times, and were upfront and honest about what all they had going on. My insurance company dropped the ball with several companies prior to them contacting 1 stop. The guy I spoke to on the phone several times was friendly and helpful, we coordinated the pick up and drop off at the shop so I could get some rest. They called me prior to Moving my job back a little to see if it would be okay for them to get a lady and child off the side of 85 on Sunday night, which I had no issue with. Seemed to stand up guys working hard to take care of everyone as best they could. They can’t control the traffic. Overall I was pleased with the service and will call again if the Jeep breaks down again. Thanks Loren and crew! I’ll recommend them to others needing towing services.

reviews.author: Doug Craver
reviews.text: I have used 1 Stop Towing many times and they have always provided quick professional service. Loren has been great to work with and you will not meet a nicer person. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Luke Hamilton
reviews.text: Thanks 1 stop towing! Needed a tow from the I285 on ramp, got to me very quickly and had my truck home in no time. Great service, friendly folks, good prices, thanks again!

reviews.author: Teresa Lane
reviews.text: I was stranded with two flat tires on the same side of my vehicle. After 2 other towing companies, Parkway Texaco and Gordon Company Transport both cancelled on me late last night, my husband came and picked me up. I didn’t want to leave my van overnight, but really didn’t have any choice. Loren called me first thing this morning, he found out exactly what was going on with the vehicle and the service I needed. He gave me the status that he had one call ahead of me and would be on his way right after. He came and picked my vehicle up and took us to the shop. Very polite and knowledgeable young man. I would definitely recommend him if you need a jump start, a vehicle unlocked or a tow!

reviews.author: deana stacey
reviews.text: Fantastic experience. My tow driver, Frankie treated me with the utmost respect. He was professional and kind. I submitted my request online. They kept me updated and ETA was provided often. My service was handled quickly and very professionally. I will request 1 Stop Towing for all my roadside needs.

reviews.author: Tina Welch
reviews.text: MR Loren Everhart towed my car. He called me to let me know he was assigned to my tow. He also called me when he arrived. He is such a kind and respectful man. I felt at ease entrusting my car to him. Loren provided excellent service!!!

reviews.author: Hilary May
reviews.text: We were unfairly caught between two landlords of a VRBO we rented for our son’s wedding. Even though our cars were towed by this company, they were gracious in helping everyone got out of town on Sunday. They are very gracious and kind.

reviews.author: r peller
reviews.text: If you need emergency auto, or repair, Go to 1 Stop Towing!!!!! Don’t even hesitate. I rarely make reviews for anything. This is beyond deserving. Please read. Our car broke down on the side of the highway near Lexington. Our insurance company dispatched 1 Stop. We left the car on the side and went home in another car. They called us and they came by later to pick it up so we wouldn’t need to stay on the highway. They offered to fix it for us, on top of picking it up!!! They fixed the major problem, which was the belt that had completely broken. Then offered to fix one of the other major problems our car had, the oxygen sensor which is hard to get to (and that would keep it from passing inspection). Then also offered to change the oil (which was about to need changed). Then, also offered to get the car inspected!!! (And they made it pass) Lastly: We live in Winston, so he offered to have us meet him in the mall, since he already had a pickup he needed to do at Forsyth Hospital. Recap: this is amazing!!! 1. Towed the car from the side of the road. 2. Made the car run again 3. Made another major repair that we needed done anyway. 4. Oil change 5. State inspection 6. Delivered the car so we didn’t have to drive to Lexington. Price: Under $400. The car runs amazing too. Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Mia Dandridge
reviews.text: Best experience with locksmith services, dispatched quickly and completed the job efficiently within 5 minutes of arrival. Our driver was so considerate and went above and beyond twice, diffusing an emergent situation with ease. We appreciated the extra effort and time taken and would recommend this company to anyone! Thank you again!

reviews.author: Gonzalo Pualuan
reviews.text: Highly Recommend! Lorn was fantastic, got the car out of a spot other tow driver from another company could not. And he showed up quickly and was a professional. Great customer service , reliable and trustworthy! Can’t thank you enough for taking excellent care of me and my car!

reviews.author: Melissa Kelly
reviews.text: Awesome tow company ! Came and towed our car at 2:30am to the shop! Driver knew exactly what was wrong with my car! Will definitely recommend them to everyone I know ! Tysm ! He took great care of my care from pickup to drop off !

reviews.author: Yukidongo
reviews.text: Excellent roadside service and towing. Came prepared for what he needed to do. Put my dead truck on a jump box so it could easily be moved out of harms way before loading it onto the tow truck. I was broken down on an exit ramp in Winston Salem, waiting for a high speed rear end collision by speeding drivers that rocked my vehicle as they passed... From 12 MN to 1:20 am. He arrived and quickly assessed the situation and I was home in 40 minutes... 31 miles away. The only hold up was the Insurance company, State Farm. He handled that nonsense, as well, for the most part. I will call him first and not the Roadside Assistance (Insurance), next time.

reviews.author: Emily Benitez
reviews.text: Was stuck in the middle of the highway at 12am. 1 Stop towing and Auto was the only service to pick up. Loren was very friendly and helpful! Prices are reasonable. Would recommend during any emergency 10/10

reviews.author: Maura Sullivan
reviews.text: Loren went above and beyond! I had been waiting on another company on the side of I-85 after running over something in the road and getting a flat. He stopped on his way to another customer and attempted to add air to my tire only to learn the rim had been punctured. He took my cell number, went to help another person and then came back to help me. He towed my car, dropped me off in a safe location to call an Uber and then stored my car on his lot for more than a week. He kept in constant communication. I would highly recommend his service!

reviews.author: John Pestoff
reviews.text: Loren was FANTASTIC! He was considerate and understanding to my situation. He towed my car from Lexington, NC to Asheville, NC and for A LOT LESS than other tow companies I called in Lexington. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND Loren and 1 Stop Towing & Auto.

reviews.author: Fernando B. Geddie Jr.
reviews.text: A few days ago I'm headed back to Winston-Salem coming from Lexington going down 52N and my old 1 ton 16 passenger work van conks out and so being about 7ish at night (after hours) I called several so called 24hr towing companies who either didn't pick up the phone or they said they where not towing, yes they where done for the day...SMH! I called the Everhart family and they were actually eating dinner but still took the call but not only that they also came and towed my big old raggedy van to my house at a very reasonable price. I even got to ride in the rollback :) I was very pleased with the service they provided and I had a great conversation with them on the way home. I would definitely use them again. I was even able to pay electronically because obviously being stuck on the side of the road with limited cash with no ATM...lol I was grateful for that. This is the type of small business I'd recommend anyone to support because these folks who are not too big for the average everyday Jack or Jill. Also and lastly I want to add this and it's that there is a cost to operate any business and prices are relative to the situation and I was not expecting it to be $20 which wouldn't pay for the diesel to fire up one of these trucks and really folks we shouldn't argue dollars for a service that is available when you need them. What price can you put on that? However I know times is hard for everybody and we're all fishing for the cheapest price but at some point you have to pay for something so if you need a tow. Pay these people instead of the other guys. Thanks!

reviews.author: Chase Snively
reviews.text: Fastest and most professional towing service I’ve ever had, even made the minor fix needed to get on my way. If you are ever in the area 1 stop towing is the best around!

reviews.author: Allison Lindsey
reviews.text: Great experience. Came as quick as possible. Friendly and polite. Towed my car and then also changed the flat tire for me. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Sharron Moody
reviews.text: I called in the morning to have a restored 1969 Corvair transported and by that afternoon it was sitting in my driveway. Loren was very prompt and professional. I would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Teresa Bowman
reviews.text: Loren is awesome! He saved us today and went above and beyond to help us! I can’t sing his praises loud enough, don’t hesitate to use his services, you will be in great hands!!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Johnson Phillips
reviews.text: What a lifesaver!! Super fast, very nice, followed up with a photo for proof of delivery! If you’re on the side of the road call these guys, they will give you a fair price and make a bad situation much better!! 10/10

reviews.author: Stevie Hege
reviews.text: Fast service and very easy to work with. Driver was very polite and helpful. I will use 1 Stop for all my towing needs in the future.

reviews.author: Samantha Kidd
reviews.text: This man was a life saver! I had been waiting on Triple A and another towing company since 8:25 pm and I called this towing company around 1:20 am and the man got to me around 2:10 am. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Darian Campbell
reviews.text: Loren’s a great guy, he bailed us out when our dodge quit running. Looks like he can haul just about anything with those rigs.

reviews.author: Timmy Pennino
reviews.text: My only choice when i need a tow!!!! This is the BEST SERVICE i have ever had!!!! HIGHLY recommended!

reviews.author: Casey Shane
reviews.text: Great service great prices! Did not mind at all getting up at 2 AM for a jumpstart . Cheapest in town!

reviews.author: John Scott
reviews.text: Exceptional service! Response time was incredibly quick for an emergency roadside assistance. In addition to the great communication and quick service they went above and beyond to help an out of state driver find a tire center that could do after hour replacements on a Sunday evening. They did not just give names, but called centers to confirm which were open, and geographically close. Could not have been happier as the parent of a young, out of state driver, who was traveling alone! Thank You!!
